name: Phantom of the Hospital
source:
Helena has always justified her irresponsible life of partying with a smile and more beer. She wanted to live life to the fullest and not waste a single day on things she saw as "boring". One day, though, one glass too much gets her into the hospital where she enjoys the company of her overly caring best friend Mel and handsome but kind of mysterious young man, Alex. She finds herself in an unexciting environment where she feels trapped.

But her boring nights become a bit more exciting when she hears a story of a ghost that roams the hospital…

[Edited from [url=https://hidden-masquerade.itch.io/the-phantom-of-the-hospital]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
海伦娜总是用微笑和更多的啤酒来为她不负责任的聚会生活辩护。她想让生活过得充实，不要把每一天浪费在她认为“无聊”的事情上。然而有一天，她喝了一杯，住进了医院，在那里她享受着过度关心的好朋友梅尔和英俊但有点神秘的年轻人亚历克斯的陪伴。她发现自己处于一个令人兴奋的环境中，感觉自己被困住了。

但当她听到一个在医院里游荡的鬼魂的故事时，她无聊的夜晚变得更加兴奋……

[编辑自[url=https://hidden-masquerade.itch.io/the-phantom-of-the-hospital]Itch.io[/url]]
